column1: # fix_id <TAB> target_file <TAB> sed_expr <TAB> test_cmd. Run through p12d_mutgate.sh, never in a checkout anyone
# is using. Every test_cmd builds its own workspace from the throwaway's files: p12d_ws.sh / p12d_pkgroot.sh copy the
# ABI and batch D's packages; p12d_core_check.sh archives the clone's committed HEAD and overlays only P1.2d's paths.
# Rows assert BATCH D'S OWN results only (compose's and herdr's shape rows, their own probes, their own own-root
# checks) -- never the whole-tree gate totals, which move as other batches land.
# No `cmd | grep -q` anywhere (pipefail/SIGPIPE): the helpers log to a file, then grep it.
# --- the registration boundary: re-inline a payload -> batch D's own shape row fails -> red
